name: schema-monolith-tables
description: DEFECT-0048: shared/schema.ts is the 18k-line schema monolith. The split into shared/schema/*.ts is under way (84 modules, 260 tables at 2026-09-28) but the monolith itself had grown to 464 tables, because nothing stopped a new table landing there. This freezes the count of pgTable( definitions in shared/schema.ts and drives it DOWN: new tables go in a domain module under shared/schema/ (re-exported through the barrel, so no import changes), and every extraction lowers the baseline. Column edits to tables still in the monolith are unaffected.
minimaNote: VACUITY FLOOR: the glob must match exactly the one monolith file. If shared/schema.ts is ever fully split and deleted, delete this ratchet with it rather than lowering the floor.
lastBumpNote: 2026-09-28: 464 -> 461. First extraction under this ratchet: founder_ad_accounts, growth_campaigns and ad_creative_bundles moved to shared/schema/growth-marketing.ts, re-exported through the barrel.
